apps.localizedDescription:
KittenTTS2-iOS:

Make speech right on your iPhone or iPad with this offline text-to-speech app. Once a model is on your device, speech is generated there too—no account or cloud service needed.

• KittenTTS 2 offers 48 preset voices, several languages, and voice cloning from a short recording.
• KittenTTS 0.8 is smaller and faster, with the original Nano, Micro, and Mini models, 8 voices, and a speed control.

QuickStart:

New to KittenTTS and don’t have model files yet? You don’t need to find or prepare a model yourself: install the app, then download one from its Models tab.

• Open Speak, select the model and a preset voice, enter text, and tap Speak.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KittenTTS uses the microphone only when you record a short reference clip for voice cloning. Audio is processed on this device and is never uploaded.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: KittenTTS can draft a transcript of your reference clip when you tap Transcribe. Recognition runs on this device only and the recording is never uploaded.
